---
title: "Before the day"
---

Before the day, install R, an IDE and the workspace, work through the first module on R, and read the background page. None of this needs an account or paid software.

## 1. R and an IDE

[Install R and an IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Install R, Quarto and an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) by following the setup page. The [help page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/help.html) lists the problems that other participants have met. If the installation fails, tell the facilitator before the day.

## 2. The workspace {#the-workspace}

[Download the workspace (zip)]({{< var cases.housing.workspace-zip >}}){.btn .btn-primary}

Save the zip file where you will find it again and unzip it, choosing "Extract All" on Windows rather than working inside the compressed preview. Open the folder that it makes, `ar4ds-housing-workspace-main`, in your IDE, with **File → Open Folder** in Positron and VS Code or by opening the file `ar4ds-housing-workspace.Rproj` inside it in RStudio. Then run `R/check_setup.R`, as the [setup page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html#check-that-it-works) describes, until every line prints OK. The tasks for the day are in the report `index.qmd` of the same folder.

## 3. Getting started with R

[Open Getting started with R](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work through the module. Its code runs in your browser, so it needs no installation.

## 4. Background {#the-case-study}

[Read the background](../../background.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The background page presents the claim on which the day works, and how the five analysts of the robustness study of SCORE (Multi100; Aczel et al. 2026) came to different conclusions about it.

## 5. The deck and the browser lab

[Open the deck at Task 1](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-1-get-yourself-running){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 1](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The deck and the browser lab run R inside your browser, and they are the fallback if your installation fails. Open the deck once on the machine and in the browser that you will use (a recent version of Chrome, Edge or Firefox), wait until the setup cell of Task 1 shows a "Run Code" button, and run it. If the deck does not load, try another browser, and tell the facilitator before the day.

## 6. Further preparation

Optional: the modules on [the IDE (Positron and other IDEs)](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html), on [Quarto documents](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html) and on [Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html), and the readings on [preregistration](../../resources.qmd#preregistration).

## 7. On the day

In person, bring your laptop, with the workspace working on it, and its charger. Online, keep the video call on one screen or device and your IDE, or the deck, on another, so that you can follow the shared screen while you work.
